question: Could you review our records in June 2022 and identify which countries have the longest streak of consecutive inserted city dates? Please list the 2-letter length country codes of these countries.
sql:
WITH june_data AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2, insert_date 
    FROM cities 
    WHERE insert_date >= '2022-06-01' AND insert_date <= '2022-06-30'
),
june_with_num AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, 
           insert_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date) as rn
    FROM june_data
),
june_groups AS (
    SELECT country_code_2,
           insert_date,
           rn,
           CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) - rn as grp
    FROM june_with_num
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, grp, COUNT(*) as streak
    FROM june_groups
    GROUP BY country_code_2, grp
),
max_streaks AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, MAX(streak) as max_streak
    FROM streaks
    GROUP BY country_code_2
)
SELECT country_code_2, max_streak
FROM max_streaks
WHERE max_streak = (SELECT MAX(max_streak) FROM max_streaks)
ORDER BY country_code_2
